exposure: first 2 months of the Iron Swords war (following October 7th Hamas attack)
outcome: rates of preterm and post-term delivery
cohort: All singleton births occurring between 7 October and 7 December 2023 in a single center in Israel, from a population not directly involved in the conflict.
finding: The study found a decrease in daily emergency admissions to the labor ward and a notable increase in stillbirth rates during the initial weeks following the Hamas attack.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in the mode of delivery between the war and control groups.
birth_weight: Neonatal birthweights were similar between groups.
gest_age: Gestational age at birth and rates of preterm/post-term delivery were similar between groups.
